item.title: A spiking neural network-in-logic architecture based on reconfigurable molybdenum disulfide dual-gate transistors with ferroelectric gating
item.description:
📚 Nature Electronics
👤 Lingqi Li, Haofei Zheng, Chenyang Li, Heng Xiang, Jianze Wang, Fangyuan Zheng 等16位作者
Nature Electronics, Published online: 14 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41928-026-01706-0 Reconfigurable dual-gate ferroelectric transistors that exhibit logic, neuronal and synapse functionalities can provide logic-based spatial pruning of inputs for a spiking neural network, reducing unnecessary neuronal activation and improving energy efficiency.

arXiv:2609.13139v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Screened hybrid functionals such as HSE06 improve the description of band gaps, charge localization, and redox energetics relative to semilocal approximations, but their explicit Hartree-Fock exchange term is computationally costly for large, periodic systems, especially in plane-wave basis set calculations. arXiv:2606.13144v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Intrinsically chiral metal surfaces, where handedness arises from the asymmetric step-kink-terrace topology of high-Miller index planes, are model systems for enantiospecific catalysis, sensing, and spintronics. item.title: Unusual phase coexistence regime across the ferroelectric - paraelectric transition
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 M. Kopecký, J. Kub, E. de Prado, J. Hlinka
arXiv:2609.12071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A PbTiO3 epitaxial thin film grown on a DyScO3 substrate was studied by x-ray diffraction in the temperature range of 20-500 degrees Celsius. It is found that the ferroelectric to paraelectric phase transition proceeds through a peculiar transitional coexistence state extending between 402 degrees Celsius and 414 degrees Celsius. Within this temperature interval, at a temperature of 405 degrees Celsius, a domain structure transition occurs, at which the three-domain c/a1/a2 polytwin phase transforms into an ordinary c/a2 twinned phase. It is proposed that the coexistence of two independent twinned phases with the paraelectric phase is enabled by vertical strain gradients in the film.

arXiv:2609.12020v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A key subtask of quantum error correction is to extract a syndrome that, if nontrivial, signals an error. item.title: Hund’s physics-driven strong correlation in the altermagnet CaCrO3
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Zhenfeng Ouyang, Peng-Jie Guo, Rong-Qiang He, Zhong-Yi Lu
Altermagnetism has attracted intense interest, but strong correlation effects in altermagnets remain largely unexplored. Here, using density functional theory plus dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT), we identify CaCrO3, a rare example of a metallic altermagnet, as a Hund altermagnet. We show that Hundness, rather than Mottness, leads to incoherent metallicity with altermagnetic spin splitting and sustains local spin moments. The DFT+DMFT calculated magnetic moment (~ 1.3 µB/Cr) is in quantitative agreement with neutron diffraction (~ 1.2 µB/Cr), while conventional DFT + U predicts an insulating state instead.
